name: giga-spatial
summary: Acquires published geospatial datasets (WorldPop, GHSL, Google and Microsoft building footprints, OpenStreetMap, Relative Wealth Index, Ookla, GloFAS, WRI Aqueduct, SRTM, HDX) into a data store you control, loads them for a country or geometry, and maps them onto H3, S2, or Mercator grids, administrative boundaries, custom polygons, points of interest, and road networks for humanitarian, development, connectivity, and climate analysis.
